llm.summary: The skill's instructions rely on SSH and file uploads to a remote host and make claims (required env vars, sandboxing/whitelisting) that are not reflected in the registry metadata or enforced in the code, creating a risk of unexpected data exfiltration and implicit use of your SSH keys.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md requires QWENSPEAK_HOST and QWENSPEAK_PORT and describes SSH access to a 'locked-down container', but the registry metadata lists no required env vars/credentials. The claimed sandboxing/whitelisting is asserted in docs but not verifiable from the skill files. This mismatch between what the skill says it needs/does and what it declares is concerning.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions direct the agent to upload/download arbitrary files (put/get), run commands via SSH, and pipe YAML configs to a remote service. Those are coherent with a remote TTS service, but they also permit arbitrary data transfer to the remote host. The wrapper auto-accepts new host keys (StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new), which weakens host identity verification and increases MITM/exfiltration risk.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; the skill is instruction-only with a small SSH wrapper script. Nothing is written to disk by an installer, reducing installation-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md requires QWENSPEAK_HOST and QWENSPEAK_PORT but the registry metadata declared none. The script uses SSH which will implicitly use the user's SSH agent/keys or default identity files for authentication—sensitive credentials not declared by the skill. That implicit access to SSH keys and the ability to transfer arbitrary files to the remote host is disproportionate to the metadata and deserves caution.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system-wide presence or modify other skills. Autonomous invocation is allowed (the platform default) but not combined here with other high privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill talks to a remote QWENSPEAK server over SSH and lets you upload and download files. Before installing: verify and trust the remote host (QWENSPEAK_HOST) and port; prefer using a dedicated SSH keypair for this service rather than your general-purpose keys; be aware the script will auto-accept new host keys (accept-new) which can hide a MITM attack—consider replacing that option with strict verification; confirm the remote service actually enforces the claimed command whitelist and sandboxing; do not send sensitive files to the service unless you trust it; and note the registry metadata omitted required env vars/credentials—ask the publisher for clarification or for the official service homepage/source before use.
